what: Where a hand-wrapped line opens with what CommonMark reads as the start of a block, which of the readers this order moved onto the shared parser return less than the base's line reader read, and whether they refuse. Each row is the base's reader (main, 0097fcac6, from an archive) run beside the candidate's on the same text. Three review workers measured the families on 2026-11-14 between 18:10 and 18:34 UTC; the reviewer ran again the rows marked so. The probes and the workers' reports are in the ignored local lane under docs/control/local/reviews/WO-276/final-review-002/.

openers.tagOfABlockElement: a line that opens with a tag whose name is an HTML block element, as a placeholder such as <title>, <dir>, <base>, <summary>, <option> or <section> is spelled: a raw HTML block that runs to the next blank line
openers.blockToItsClosingTag: a line that opens with <pre>, <script>, <style>, <textarea> or an unclosed comment: a raw HTML block that runs to its closing tag, across blank lines
openers.quotationOrListMarker: a line that opens with a greater-than sign, or with a hyphen, a plus sign, an asterisk or `1.` before a space: a quotation or a list item, whose later lines are its lazy continuation
openers.setextUnderline: a line of hyphens or equals signs straight under text: the text becomes a heading
openers.fence: a line that opens with three backticks or tildes: a fenced code block to its closing fence

recordHoldsNoInstance.orders: 1,196 revisions of every order in main's history read equally in header and criteria, but for one named difference and this order as filed (history-differential.json); a worker's reading of 1,590 revisions and the 273 working orders agrees
recordHoldsNoInstance.followUpSources: 1,500 sources read equally but for two re-keyed candidates the register already disposes
recordHoldsNoInstance.objectives: 538 Objective and Non-goals readings of the 269 orders read equally
recordHoldsNoInstance.nearInstances: three committed orders hold a wrapped line that opens with such a placeholder inside a list item, where it is harmless (WO-083 line 457, WO-263 line 280, WO-266 line 255), and this order as filed held one that ended its criteria list, which FINAL-001 found and the repair now refuses
